article.title: Buyer to apply for delivery.
article.content: Apart from any express contract, the seller of goods is not bound to delivery them until the buyer applies for delivery.
article.html:
35Buyer to apply for delivery.

Section 35 · Chapter IV · page 10 of the Act

Apart from any express contract, the seller of goods is not bound to delivery them until the buyer applies for delivery.
